_comment: UnboundBot — Alpaca PAPER FAST (intraday) executor config. This is a SECOND, DISJOINT order process running the 5m MomentumAlt strategy over the experimental alts (ETH/XRP/DOT/LINK) so they can buy/sell intraday (owner directive 2026-10-21). dry_run=false sends REAL orders to the paper endpoint. It NEVER trades BTC — the daily baseline stays on config.alpaca.paper.json. Do NOT run until the owner approves paper order flow.
_warning: If the ccxt url override ever fails, orders could target live. Verify the resolved endpoint with check_alpaca.py before trading. Rotate the exposed keys. This process shares the GLOBAL risk policy (paper_risk_policy.json), kill-switch, equity snapshot and cross-executor open_exposure ledger with the daily bot — the two whitelists are disjoint so the worst-case global exposure (BTC 5000 + 4x1000 alts = 9000) stays under the 10000 / 10%-equity cap.
_sizing_note: BOUNDED intraday PAPER_AUTONOMOUS sizing. stake_amount=1000 is the per-alt base; MomentumAlt inherits PaperAutonomous.custom_stake_amount + confirm_trade_entry, which enforce: per-alt cap 1000, max planned loss 500 (via the -0.03 stop), one position per pair, kill-switch, fresh-equity gate, and the GLOBAL exposure cap computed as this executor's own open stake PLUS the daily executor's contribution read from app/state/open_exposure.json (fail-closed if that ledger is stale). Entries are automatic (no per-trade approval); unsafe ones are rejected and explained. PAPER ONLY — spot, long-only, no leverage.

exchange.name: alpaca
exchange._secrets_note: Keys are injected at runtime from D:\BOT\.env via FREQTRADE__EXCHANGE__KEY/SECRET by app/scripts/run_paper.py --fast. Never hardcode here (this file is committed).
exchange._ft_has_note: Alpaca is not a Freqtrade-native exchange; its ccxt fetch_ohlcv returns ONLY the current partial bar without a 'since' timestamp. ohlcv_require_since=true forces the historic-fetch path so the full 5m history needed for the EMA9/EMA21/vol-MA20 warm-up is returned.

telegram._note: Disabled to avoid the Telegram getUpdates Conflict with the daily bot (only one instance may poll a token). The read-only crypto_status_monitor sends this executor's 🟢/✅/🔴 trade alerts and per-asset status via sendMessage (it reads BOTH trade DBs), so the owner is still notified of every fast trade without a second polling bot.

_force_entry_note: Owner may enable force_entry + a localhost api_server to run a CONTROLLED test trade through the veto layer (used 2026-10-21 to verify the buy AND exit paths). Left OFF by default: forced entries are a testing affordance, not part of autonomous operation. The fee-in-base exit blocker found during that test is now FIXED (see Memory.md + app/exchange_ext/alpaca_fees.py): Alpaca settles crypto fees net-of-position and reports no fee, so the thin layer derives the base fee from the broker wallet at get_real_amount, reducing the trade to the net credited amount so exits close cleanly.
